model.what: the model's own forecast (data/congress/REPORT.md section 2), fitted on earlier cycles only, from what was known before the election (the orchestrator, 2026-11-07 05:58); no polls are used, so it carries less than forecasters then knew

calibration.note: k = the root mean square of z = (y - mean) / sd over these earlier years' races, each year forecast from its own earlier cycles

model.mean_is: 1/2 + national_forecast + b_lean * lean + b_inc * incumbency + b_lag * (last governor race's Democratic share - 1/2)
model.sd_is: sqrt(national_sd^2 + s_e^2); national_sd = k s_a sqrt(1 + z (Z'Z)^-1 z'), s_e = k s_e_fitted, z = (1, midterm * P, (1 - midterm) * P), P = +1 Democratic president, -1 Republican; k the calibration factor

variant.note: the mean as fitted, normal tails first (no variant of round 5 passed its test for this level; REPORT 2.7)

near_tie.note: not adopted for this level: on the years it reaches it does not both raise the log score and bring the near-even count nearer (REPORT 2.6)

The two counts are 9.6% to 11.4% apart for every candidate, unsettled, so p is not computed, and the contest is left out of the fits and of West Virginia 2016's last governor race

the count (pipeline/governor_counts.py): the count is not taken, and the contest is held. The West Virginia Secretary of State's results page for the general of 2012-11-06 (https://apps.sos.wv.gov/elections/results/results.aspx?year=2012&eid=13&county=Statewide, read 2026-11-13T05:30:03Z, sha256 727254f3b6f77b79) gives Tomblin 335,468, Maloney 303,291, Johnson 16,787 and Moran 8,909, 'Official Total Votes: 664,455', against this record's 297,207, 273,130, 15,179 and 7,934 (Cha, Kuriwaki and Snyder), each 9.6% to 11.4% under it [measured]. The page is headed '★★★ Official Results ★★★' but says that its results 'should not be relied on as official results until certified', that they 'do not include write-in candidate information', and 'Number of Precincts 1892 Number of Precincts Reporting 1846' [stated]; Algara and Amlani's county returns give Tomblin 335,468 and Maloney 303,291, the page's figures to the vote [measured], so they are its copy. The orchestrator, 2026-11-13 06:52: "hold it; do not take the page's count ... its heading is not the 15:16 mark: the agency's own words deny it ... That gap is unsettled and 5% or more, so 19:04 holds it". p is not computed, and the contest is left out of D2's fits and of West Virginia 2016's last-governor-race input (data/local/REPORT.md section 35)
